meta.prompt:
Create a minimal single-field form for phone number, filling available width up to 384px. Stack the “Phone number” label, a telephone input with telephone autofill, and a compact primary Submit button with 16px spacing between the field and button. Use neutral theme-aware borders, rounded controls, and visible keyboard focus.

Require 8–15 digits, starting with a nonzero digit, with an optional leading plus sign. Start with an empty value, validate on submission, and show field errors beneath the control with invalid styling and an accessible invalid state. Associate the label with the control. A valid submission stays on the form without a success screen or external action.
